description: This Java class implements an immutable command for modifying features in a live context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends base command classes and overrides methods related to command execution and response handling.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand, encapsulating the logic to modify features in a live context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Command object, casting it to ModifyFeatures.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the Features object associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the command's answer response.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name and super class info.
